tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run every static gate (lint, types, quality, guardrails, typed, dup, deps). Run before any PR.

tools.name: run_gates
tools.description: Run the agent gate sweep and write a machine-readable pass/fail report to .agent/report.json.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Base eslint correctness and style across all TS/TSX.

tools.name: typecheck
tools.description: TypeScript strict compile (tsc --noEmit); no any, no unsound casts.

tools.name: quality
tools.description: Duplication, cognitive complexity, and the as-unknown-as ban.

tools.name: guardrails
tools.description: AI discipline: comment ban, size and shape limits, named constants, env access, UTC dates.

tools.name: typed
tools.description: Type-aware: no floating or misused promises, switch exhaustiveness, only-throw-error.

tools.name: deps
tools.description: knip: no unlisted dependencies or binaries.

tools.name: deadcode
tools.description: knip dead-code ratchet: unused counts may only shrink.

tools.name: lint_gates
tools.description: Keep the CLAUDE.md gate table in sync with the gate scripts.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Fail if line coverage falls below the recorded floor.

tools.name: format
tools.description: Write prettier formatting across the tracked source globs.

tools.name: quick
tools.description: Fast inner loop: typecheck plus vitest on changed files.
